questions.question: Which Major League Baseball team clinched their very first World Series title by defeating the Tampa Bay Rays?
questions.explanation: The Milwaukee Brewers won the World Series in five games against the Tampa Bay Rays, marking the first championship in their franchise history.
questions.context: 2026 World Series: In Major League Baseball, the Milwaukee Brewers defeat the Tampa Bay Rays in five games to win their first World Series championship in franchise history.

questions.question: Food delivery giant DoorDash announced plans to acquire which grocery delivery platform in a 17-billion-dollar deal?
questions.explanation: DoorDash revealed an agreement to buy grocery delivery specialist Instacart, aiming to complete the transaction in late 2027.
questions.context: American food delivery company DoorDash announces an intent to close on an acquisition of grocery delivery company Instacart for $17 billion in late 2027.

questions.question: In which European country did the parliamentary speaker propose Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist to lead a broad coalition government?
questions.explanation: Swedish parliamentary speaker Andreas Norlén put forward Center Party leader Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist to head a multi-party coalition.
questions.context: 2026 Swedish government formation: Andreas Norlén, speaker of the Swedish parliament, announces a second vote to elect the next prime minister. He proposes a coalition led by the Center Party's leader, Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist, alongside the Social Democrats, Greens, Christian Democrats, and the Moderates.

questions.question: In which country did a famous rock formation known as a hoodoo collapse at Göreme's Open Air Museum following days of heavy rain?
questions.explanation: A hoodoo collapsed at the Open Air Museum in the Nevşehir District of Turkey after persistent downpours.
questions.context: Three people are killed and five more injured during the collapse of a hoodoo at Göreme's Open Air Museum in the Nevşehir District, Turkey. It is suspected to be caused by heavy rainfall over the preceding days.

questions.question: Which central bank's president announced her resignation ahead of schedule, citing an inability to stay neutral regarding current events?
questions.explanation: Christine Lagarde announced she will leave her post as head of the European Central Bank in February 2027, eight months before the end of her term.
questions.context: Christine Lagarde, the president of the European Central Bank, resigns, saying she could not remain neutral on current events. She will step down from office in February 2027, eight months before her term officially ends.
